psychological_meaning: Deep Koamaru evokes feelings of sophistication, mystery, and introspection. It is associated with intelligence, stability, and depth. The color promotes contemplation and can instill a sense of calmness and security. Its darker hue can also represent power and authority, while its underlying blue notes provide a sense of trustworthiness and reliability.
